research_scope: Current sparse-attention implementation practice, trace semantics, reproducible model provenance, and systems benchmarking.

speculation: The highest-value asset may be the claim-compiler discipline itself, not the current sparse-attention mechanism. It could become a reusable architecture-evaluation framework across KV compression, routing, quantization, and memory systems.

The current sparse lane may already have supplied its main value: it exposed how selector accuracy, score construction, metadata traffic, materialization, and omitted score semantics erase apparent wins. Further progress likely requires co-design with an existing GPU kernel substrate.

A small immutable trace corpus with exact score contracts, reference attention outputs, runtime receipts, and named kernels would likely create more scientific leverage than hundreds of additional idea/question entries.
The current provenance gate is a consistency and reviewer-policy gate, not cryptographic proof that a bundle truly came from the named public model.
